# agentic-powered-golden-path-demo

> Natural-language → GitOps developer onboarding demo (ArgoCD + OpenRouter). The origin of the lineage that became Turbo Flow (developer tool) and Turbo Rig (DevOps tool for AI coding agents).

agentic-powered-golden-path-demo is maintained by Adventure Wave Labs (The lab for agentic developer tooling).
